selection_method: geometry/source-frame dedup screening; visually inspected 160 cropped candidates, full-image reviewed selected20; conservative subset, not exhaustive quality annotation
label_warning: Source labels describe body/hoodie categories, not helmet/head boxes. Neither class is automatically converted to helmeted_head/no_helmet_head. Source includes detection and polygon rows; selected20 have detection-format rows.
